What I can do:

- **On request:** Message me each morning (for example, "coastal digest") and I'll DM you a summary of new posts in #coastal-team since the last one. You're a member, so I can read it for you.
- **Catch-up now:** I can summarise what's been posted in #coastal-team so far, if you want to start from here.

If you need a true scheduled send, someone with scheduling access will have to set it up on the platform side.
